quotes.text: Cancel or refund Stripe Terminal payments.

old_evidence.text: Canceling a PaymentIntent releases all uncaptured funds, and a canceled PaymentIntent can no longer be used to perform charges.
The JavaScript SDK and server-driven integration require you to cancel the `PaymentIntent` on your server.
as an integer in cents (or the charge currency’s smallest currency unit)

findings: November is a five-variant index (server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native). It establishes topic and routing only. May is the complete combined functional guide for cancellation before capture and refund after capture.

The May guide keeps client SDK cancellation available for iOS, Android and React Native, requiring server-side cancellation for JS and server-driven paths. Other client SDK integrations can fall back to the server when needed information is unavailable in the app.

May distinguishes online refund eligibility from Canada's in-person Interac procedure on eligible readers. Refund using the underlying Charge or PaymentIntent ID on the ordinary server-side path, with partial amount in the charge currency's smallest unit.

The November raw contains the variant index and direct platform links, while full details remain dated to May. The textual diff joins a removal and insertion at its final-line boundary. Use the two raw captures as authority for the link text and content.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve the 2026-05-01 date despite the 2025 filename. Use actual capture state to distinguish cancellation releasing holds and making the Intent unusable from a refund's treatment of the captured underlying charge. The guide recommends daily backend reconciliation.

Preserve the five documented network types for uncaptured cancellation and the single-message Interac/eftpos distinction. Describe capture on the actual routed payment. In Canada's Interac procedure, re-present the original card and preserve currency matching and the documented server-driven in-person reader endpoint from the separately dated regional guide.
Retain iOS/Android/React Native client actors, JavaScript/server-driven backend actors, and separately sourced v6 refund method and private-preview conditions.
conflicts: The source and both Terminal concepts say Interac cannot be refunded by API, but the 2026-04-24 regional capture (raw/stripe-terminal-regional-2025.md:437-447) excludes ordinary online/API or Dashboard refund and expressly provides an in-person Terminal reader refund_payment endpoint for server-driven integrations. Narrow the API claim in relevant routes and flag the same shorthand in the companion regional source.
The source and stripe-terminal-refunds concept use cents alone. May line 140 says the charge currency's smallest unit. Restore this qualification.

The May confirmed-PaymentIntent example describes a pre-capture window, but its own automatic/manual distinction and later separately sourced 6.0.0 SDK defaults mean confirmation alone doesn't establish an uncaptured state. Keep the already recorded exact SDK/version caveats scoped.

findings: Add the separately labeled November five-variant index link next to the full May primary evidence.
conflicts: Correct the existing cents-only wording and distinguish the prohibited ordinary online Interac refund from the regional guide's server-driven in-person Terminal reader endpoint. Preserve version and network qualifications.
source_assessments.reason: The new capture is a navigation index, while two existing historical summary claims merit independent correction from retained evidence.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/refunds, source-stripe-terminal-refunds should use the 2026-11-07 capture for server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native navigation. It names the cancel/refund topic without specifying actors, prerequisites or state transitions (new raw lines 5-17). The full 2026-05-01 guide distinguishes automatic and manual capture. The app can cancel an authorized, uncaptured card_present PaymentIntent, releasing the hold and making that Intent unusable for charging. For an already captured Intent the captured Charge must be refunded (old raw lines 8-20 and old raw lines 24-35). The iOS, Android and React Native apps can cancel client-side. JavaScript and server-driven integrations cancel on the server, and other SDK integrations can use the server when required data is unavailable in the app (old raw lines 33-47 and old raw lines 108-112). For captured payments the historical guide documents an online server-side refund with Charge or PaymentIntent ID and no card re-presentment, except for Interac in Canada, for which it routes to the eligible in-person reader flow. Partial refund amount is expressed in the charge currency's smallest unit (old raw lines 122-140). The mapped summary correctly keeps the pre/post-capture and SDK split but needs the unit and Interac API wording clarified. The 2026-04-24 regional capture expressly documents a server-driven in-person Terminal reader endpoint (raw/stripe-terminal-regional-2025.md:437-447).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/refunds, record source-stripe-terminal-refunds' 2026-11-07 index and its five exact platform destinations (new raw lines 9-17), replacing the combined capture as navigation evidence only. May 1's implementation detail and embedded platform routes remain available as historical authority (old raw lines 1-2 and old raw lines 33-51 and old raw lines 71-95). A change in format provides no proof of removal of any cancellation or refund behavior. Preserve actual uncaptured-versus-captured state, Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover/girocard cancellation, single-message Interac and eftpos and the daily reconciliation recommendation (old raw lines 8-20 and old raw lines 24-31). Preserve Interac's Canadian in-person requirement and eligible readers, but scope API/Dashboard exclusion to ordinary online refund routes because the separate April regional guide gives a server-driven in-person refund_payment endpoint with original card and currency conditions (old raw lines 122-128 and raw/stripe-terminal-regional-2025.md:437-447). Express partial amount in the charge currency's smallest unit (old raw line 140). Keep both dated raw links and reciprocal stripe-terminal-refunds, stripe-terminal, Stripe index and company routes. Keep the linked source-stripe-terminal-regional path for the Interac procedure, and retain separate iOS/Android SDK 6.0.0 scope and preview/capture qualifications in the concept.
